description: This is a Java class representing the OrderAccount entity in an e-commerce system, including its fields, relationships, and basic accessor methods.

classes.name: OrderAccount
classes.description: Entity class mapping to the ORDER_ACCOUNT table, encapsulating order account details and relationships.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the OrderAccount.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the OrderAccount.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Associates a new Order with this OrderAccount.

methods.name: getOrderAccountStartDate
methods.description: Returns a clone of the start date of the account period.

methods.name: setOrderAccountStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date for the account period, cloning the input date.

methods.name: getOrderAccountEndDate
methods.description: Returns a clone of the end date of the account period.

methods.name: setOrderAccountEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date for the account period, cloning the input date.

methods.name: getOrderAccountBillDay
methods.description: Returns the billing day of the month.

methods.name: setOrderAccountBillDay
methods.description: Sets the billing day of the month.

methods.name: getOrderAccountProducts
methods.description: Returns the set of associated OrderAccountProduct entities.

methods.name: setOrderAccountProducts
methods.description: Associates a set of OrderAccountProduct entities with this OrderAccount.
